control.title: Internal audit and compliance checks
control.description: Run an internal audit programme with impartial auditors, and periodically check compliance with security policies and standards.

evidence_hint: Internal audit plan, audit report and findings tracker.
acceptance_criteria: An internal audit plan covers the management system and controls
An audit report from the review period lists findings
Findings are tracked to owners and due dates

criteria_coverage.criterion: An internal audit plan covers the management system and controls
An audit report from the review period lists findings
Findings are tracked to owners and due dates

requirements.title: Ongoing and separate evaluations
requirements.guidance: Evaluate whether controls are present and functioning, for example internal audits and pen tests.

requirements.title: Internal audits, external audit, half-yearly VAPT and PCI reports
requirements.guidance: Quarterly internal and annual external audit reports to the IT committee, half-yearly VAPT, and PCI DSS AOC or ROC.

requirements.title: Internal audit: general
requirements.guidance: Run internal audits at planned intervals to check the ISMS conforms and is effective.

requirements.title: Internal audit programme
requirements.guidance: Plan the audit programme with criteria, scope, impartial auditors and reporting to management.

requirements.title: Independent review of information security
requirements.guidance: Have the security approach reviewed independently at planned intervals or on major change.

requirements.title: Compliance with policies, rules and standards
requirements.guidance: Regularly check compliance with security policies and standards.
